description: This is a C# source file defining the CosmosGrainStorage class, which implements Orleans grain storage using Azure Cosmos DB. The class manages reading, writing, and clearing grain state, initializes Cosmos DB resources, and includes detailed logging.

classes.name: CosmosGrainStorage
classes.description: A class that implements Orleans IGrainStorage backed by Azure Cosmos DB, handling storage operations, initialization, and resource management with detailed logging.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state of a grain from Cosmos DB, handling not found and exceptions, and updating grain state accordingly.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the current grain state to Cosmos DB, handling concurrency via ETags and potential conflicts.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Removes or resets the grain state in Cosmos DB, with options for deletion or overwriting based on configuration.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage to lifecycle events for initialization.

methods.name: GetKeyString
methods.description: Generates a unique string key for a grain ID, sanitizing components.

methods.name: BuildPartitionKey
methods.description: Asynchronously obtains the partition key for a grain.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Cosmos DB client, creates resources if enabled, and sets up the container.

methods.name: InitializeCosmosClient
methods.description: Creates and assigns the CosmosDB client instance.

methods.name: TryCreateResources
methods.description: Creates the Cosmos DB database and container, configuring indexing and partition key.

methods.name: TryDeleteDatabase
methods.description: Deletes the Cosmos DB database if it exists (used during resource cleanup).

methods.name: ResetGrainState
methods.description: Resets the grain state to a default instance, clears ETag and flags.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a specified type using the activator provider.
